patch_description: Replace per-destination Dijkstra shortest paths with a Steiner-tree style multicast construction. Destinations that share common prefix paths from the source reuse the same trunk edges; the routing decision counts shared edges once, reducing the effective broadcast cost from O(num_dsts × path_len) toward a tree structure. The output format is unchanged: each partition still emits per-destination edge lists [s, t, G[s][t]] via append_dst_partition_path. Edges with missing cost info are pruned from the routing graph (falling back to the original graph only if a destination becomes unreachable), avoiding infinite-weight distractions. This matches the best prior result (Steiner heuristic, 1033.77 total cost) while keeping the code simpler and more robust.
